name: Hotel Edelweiß
beschreibung: Hotel Edelweiß in Götzens provides a welcoming alpine base in Tyrol close to Innsbruck. In summer, the surrounding mountain landscape is traversed by numerous hiking trails, while winter brings easy access to nearby ski resorts. The interior features authentic Tyrolean craftsmanship with local wood and natural stone. Guests can unwind in the wellness area featuring a sauna and steam bath, or enjoy culinary highlights in the restaurant focusing on fresh regional ingredients.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Edelweiß in Götzens offers traditional Tyrolean hospitality near Innsbruck, complete with a sauna wellness area, regional cuisine, and year-round alpine recreation.
